hypotheses.name: Gravity step-versus-compact-source shape test
hypotheses.physical_signature: At several frozen scales, compare normalized horizontal derivative width and signed east/south gradient patterns with simple extended-step and compact-source responses. Band 11 is a verified signed southward directional derivative and Band 18 a signed eastward derivative; neither should be treated as a conventional vertical-gravity derivative. Band 5 is the horizontal gradient magnitude.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: An extended buried basement step could generate a coherent cross-strike response that is not captured by a single gradient maximum; rejecting compact-source-like anomalies may favor long, concealed discontinuities without using catalogue distance.
hypotheses.novelty: A 2026-10-23 review proposed the source-shape comparison, but no explicit step-versus-compact likelihood or response-ratio model was found in scripts/ or src/. H86F-GZZD and H86H-PSTD use gravity derivatives/tensors, and H86K-PSC now uses Hessian saddle/ridge topology, but none implements this explicit competing-source model comparison.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: An elongated intrusive contact, basin-margin facies change, or overlapping compact sources that happen to form a linear gradient corridor.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low-to-medium qualitative potential; shape consistency may reject some isolated bodies, but a long lithologic contact can mimic a fault step.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; requires scale-matched forward templates, verified coordinate/sign conventions, and sensitivity analysis to source depth and bandwidth.
hypotheses.falsifier: Step-source likelihood fails to outperform compact/contact controls on paired spatial-block HOLDOUT-DTI or changes rank materially across reasonable filter scales.

hypotheses.name: Steerable 8-azimuth log-Cauchy quadrature wavelet step-vs-dike symmetry phase with Poisson-ratio jump
hypotheses.physical_signature: Use an 8-azimuth log-Cauchy quadrature filter bank to distinguish odd-symmetric fault-step phase from even-symmetric dike/channel phase in RTP and gravity, then gate the score by lateral changes in the Garland-style RTP/gravity Poisson-ratio proxy. Freeze scales and denominator regularization before holdout evaluation.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: An unmapped, low-throw basement step may retain odd-symmetric edge phase beneath cover, while Northern Nevada Rift dikes produce strong even-symmetric magnetic ridges. This is a proposed discriminator, not evidence that a fault is present.
hypotheses.novelty: Preregistered as H86K-CWQA in registry/h86k_hypotheses.json but no corresponding executable run or run card was found in this checkout. It differs from H86J-MPC/MCSP orientation-pooled isotropic Riesz features by using steerable azimuthal phase and a cross-potential-field ratio gate. Checkout-scoped only; not a global novelty claim.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Steep intrusive pluton-wall contacts and linear volcanic/dike margins; ratio instability where the gravity denominator is small.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low-to-medium qualitative potential: phase symmetry could reject some dikes, but geology and the ratio gate may be nonspecific or unstable.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-to-medium; directional FFT filter bank, scale controls, denominator stability and paired spatial-block controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: Odd-phase candidate fails to beat phase-free gravity/magnetic controls on paired spatial-block HOLDOUT-DTI, leakage canary AUC exceeds 0.90, or results are unstable across frozen reasonable scales.

hypotheses.name: Directional hanging-wall rollover fiber curvature with paired antithetic keystone-graben predictor
hypotheses.physical_signature: Measure dip-normal directional second derivative of basin thickness in a frozen 1.5–4.5 km hanging-wall standoff from range-front master faults and test whether predicted tensile-fiber maxima identify paired intrabasin structures. Any visible-fault-derived geometry must be fold-safe and masked exactly as specified.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Antithetic intrabasin faults may be concealed beneath valley fill and lack the surface expression of the mapped range-front master fault. The proposed rollover mechanics do not establish that such features are present in the holdout.
hypotheses.novelty: Preregistered as H86K-BFAH in registry/h86k_hypotheses.json. No exact directional Xiao–Suppe rollover curvature candidate or run card was found in this checkout; a scalar hinge proxy appears in the H86K-STDP method, so this proposal has partial-family overlap and must be treated cautiously.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Differential compaction synclines draped over buried paleotopographic bedrock highs; uncertainty in the gravity-derived basement surface.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low/speculative qualitative potential; geological mechanism is plausible but proxy specificity and dependence on derived basement depth are substantial risks.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-to-medium; directional geometry, fold-safe visible-fault conditioning, sensitivity and compaction controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: No positive paired improvement over basement-gradient and scalar-hinge controls, instability to standoff choice, or evidence that the score is driven by visible-fault geometry.

required_before_any_experiment: An explicit single assigned method paragraph; the current request has none.
The actual shared cached feature stack with preprocessing and visible-mask identity; native-band rebuilding is not an acceptable substitute.
The repository's fail-closed protocol disposition; do not bypass the literal witness stop or modify uniqueness thresholds.
A complete current same-grid registry and explicit treatment of incompatible registry entries.
Frozen buffered whole-segment hide-and-recover folds; derive catalogue features from visible faults only and mask visible pixels exactly.
Run isolated-feature leakage canaries before trust; discriminative AUC above 0.90 is a stop pending proof.
Use the shared evaluate_holdout.py, pooled DTI with alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, and a 300 m triangular kernel; report evaluator, withheld-positive count, and 95% CI.
Measure rank correlation before placement and 3-pixel dot overlap on the final dots against the complete registry; stop at rho > 0.90 or overlap > 0.70.
Stop after at most three experiments or two hours, and do not select a weekly submission slot here.
Assign exactly one method paragraph; no assignment means no method is implemented.
Restore/verify the shared feature cache and exact inputs with provenance; do not substitute a private cache or native-only stack.
Resolve the literal uniqueness stop and complete like-for-like registry raster/dot measurements without weakening thresholds.
Preregister one candidate and run leakage canaries plus buffered whole-segment holdout using the shared evaluator/writer before any slot decision.
